subject: math
description: Construct perpendicular lines using a straightedge, ruler, protractor, or set square, then explain why the result forms right angles.
learningObjectives: Identify perpendicular lines and right angles in diagrams and real-life objects
Use correct notation such as AB perpendicular CD
Construct a perpendicular line through a point on a given line
Construct a perpendicular line from a point not on a given line
Check a construction by verifying 90-degree angles
Explain why a construction forms perpendicular lines
prerequisites: Name points, lines, rays, and segments from diagrams
Recognize that a right angle measures exactly 90 degrees
Use a ruler, straightedge, protractor, or set square with care
